changes.text: Every tree on one screen — your class passives and up to five skills — with the next node to take shown big and green, and the whole route after it.
Load a build straight from a Maxroll planner link, or paste export codes. Save codes as templates to reuse them.
Up to 6 phases (Leveling → Endgame). Switching phase keeps every point you already hold and lists exactly which nodes to respec, which skills to despecialize and which mastery to pick.
Clear all progress in every phase at once (Ctrl+Shift+Delete), with Undo.
Each character keeps its own build and progress: your main, your alts, your next-season character.
The app checks your Maxroll guide once a day. When the author changes it, you review what changed and apply it without losing progress.
F1–F6 tick points off while the game has focus (Shift to undo), with a sound for each press. Holding a key never burns points, and every key can be changed.
Mini mode (Ctrl+M): a small always-on-top window with one line per tree.
Game data for the current season, with node icons. After a patch, a short card tells you what to check.
A Windows installer that updates itself in the background, or a portable version.
A check of the release process — nothing changed in the app.
Combine phases from two Maxroll guides (say, one for leveling and one for endgame) and from pasted codes, in the order you choose.
Every guide in a build is checked for updates, and only the phases from the guide that changed are updated.
Checking for updates works again. Settings › Updates › Check now answers right there, with the real reason when a check fails.
Pop-up messages no longer hide behind open windows such as Settings or Load build.
See what changed in every version — by version or by feature — from What's new in the status bar. After an update, the app offers to show you.

Share a build with one short code (characters menu › Share this build). Whoever pastes it in Load build › From a share code gets every phase in your order, synced with its guides — never your progress.
Pasting export codes one phase at a time is retired: load from a Maxroll link or a share code. Templates you saved before still open.
A shared build keeps getting its guides' updates. If Maxroll is down when you load one, it uses the routes as they were shared and syncs later.
